primary_task.target: Current self-reported sleepiness on the Karolinska Sleepiness Scale, original 1-9 scale

rules: Never use synthetic fixtures for training or evaluation; they are engineering checks only.
Never pool incompatible labels (KSS, RLDD classes, YawDD events, CogBeacon reports, anxiety) into one target.
Split by participant AND recording before windowing or augmentation; overlapping windows and augmented copies stay in the same split.
Fit preprocessing, imputation, feature selection, thresholds and hyperparameters on development data only.
Reserve untouched test data; do not re-tune on it.
A source citation alone never marks a dataset trained_on or validated_on.
No accuracy percentage without an actual evaluation report.

supporting_tasks.target: Original mouth-event labels after archive inspection
Original documented endpoint; no consumer stress claim
